title: Comparison passports 2.0
summary: Publish decision-grade compatibility passports for all twelve dossiers while preserving Context only where no common contract exists.
record_scope: Comparison passports 2.0 records governed by the stated publication boundaries.
publication_boundaries: Alternative official-source discovery expands the review shelf; it does not by itself admit evidence or answer a mission.
Calendar-bound checks remain unoperated until their lawful date, and shared-date gates retain separate identities, decisions, and receipts.
No project stage, place state, longitudinal observation, comparison verdict, outcome, score, rank, causal finding, recommendation, owner decision, or public-launch authorization is inferred.
A bounded repository result describes the reviewed corpus and search path; it never proves that qualifying evidence does not exist elsewhere.

comparison_passports.title: Compute, power and water

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The files can be compared as evidence chains: named demand, public authority, infrastructure commitment, implementation milestone and the still-missing accepted-service record.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Power demand, wafer output, water use and economic value use different entities, periods and denominators; they cannot be normalized into a project-performance comparison.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Facility-specific accepted utility service, commissioning, qualification, customer acceptance and repeated output records with stable denominators.

comparison_passports.title: Permission is not operation

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: Each file exposes the boundary between permission or commitment and a later receiving-system event.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Different legal instruments do not confer equivalent authority, and an approved land-use file cannot be compared as performance with a mine, launch site or semiconductor facility.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: The next case-specific enactment, condition-clearance, permit, inspection, commissioning, acceptance or recurring-operation artifact named in each Atlas file.

comparison_passports.title: Standards to adoption

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The cases can be read against a common adoption chain from rule or framework to an identified receiving system and observable implementation event.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Cryptographic migration, assurance evaluation, broadband adoption and autonomous service have incompatible units and acceptance authorities.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Stable inventories, named receiving organizations, acceptance criteria, dated cutovers and repeated-use records that distinguish availability from adoption.

comparison_passports.title: Autonomous service and public accountability

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: Both files connect public authority to a named passenger-facing service and expose the additional records needed to evaluate access and reliability.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Autonomous-vehicle miles and accessible-station delivery are different service units and must not be collapsed into one mobility score.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Repeated service, accessibility, complaint, incident and exposure series with stable geography, fleet or station identities and revision notes.

comparison_passports.title: Research to assurance

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The cases share a progression from technical framework to institutional use, with explicit separation between evaluation, authorization and operation.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Test results, procurement actions, migration progress and service outcomes are distinct claim types and cannot substitute for one another.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Receiving-institution acceptance, deployed configuration, monitoring, exception handling and repeated mission-use records tied to the evaluated system.

comparison_passports.title: Minerals to manufacturing

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The selected files can be compared as conversion sequences from financed or permitted capacity to qualified, receiver-visible production.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Mineral tonnes, semiconductor wafers and component output are not compatible denominators and do not support a cross-industry productivity ranking.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Named commissioning and process-qualification records, customer acceptance, repeat lots or units, yield and delivery data, and disclosed interruptions.

comparison_passports.title: Space capacity to mission cadence

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: Each case distinguishes a capacity-enabling milestone from later mission or readiness evidence.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Launch cadence, aircraft delivery and fleet availability have different assets, missions, periods and denominators.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Named asset acceptance, range or base availability, repeat mission records, downtime and exception reporting for a stable cohort and period.

comparison_passports.title: Housing and infrastructure conversion

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The files reveal how local authority and infrastructure conditions create sequential delivery gates.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Dwelling units, data-center load and fab capacity cannot be compared as equivalent outputs, and regional aggregates cannot stand in for project delivery.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Enacted instruments, cleared conditions, permits, completed servicing, inspections, occupancy or accepted facility-service records at the named site.

comparison_passports.title: Climate, water and industrial resilience

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The cases can be checked for whether hazard, water, safety and operating boundaries are named at the same asset or receiving system.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Hazard projections, water agreements, safety events and production performance describe different phenomena and cannot be blended into a resilience score.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Compatible site-level resource use, hazard exposure, interruption, recovery and repeated-operation measures with asset identities and revision history.

comparison_passports.title: Workforce to qualified capacity

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The records can be compared for the presence or absence of links between workforce preparation and receiver-accepted output.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Graduates, jobs, headcount, units delivered and availability are not interchangeable measures of capacity.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Role-level qualification, placement and retention joined to line qualification, accepted output, yield and delivery cadence for the same facility and period.

comparison_passports.title: Finance, risk and infrastructure

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The cases show where financial commitment sits within a longer infrastructure-delivery chain.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Loan values, utility investments, storage capacities and service obligations use different boundaries and cannot support a return or project-quality ranking.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Financial close or obligation joined to expenditure, physical completion, acceptance, service, operating performance and disclosed risk allocation.

comparison_passports.title: Observation to outcome

compatibility_dimensions.identity: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
compatibility_dimensions.geography: Exact place and project joins are retained; geographic adjacency is not treated as equivalence.

comparison_passports.comparable_claim: The files can be compared as examples of how evidence advances—or stops—between a dated observation and an outcome claim.
comparison_passports.prohibited_comparison: Stations, waste batches, broadband locations, production units and evaluation results are deliberately non-equivalent outcome units.
comparison_passports.decisive_next_evidence: Repeated compatible measures for stable entities and periods, documented revisions and uncertainty, and a bounded attribution design appropriate to the claim.
